mapper.select: SELECT d AS date, SUM(cnt) AS count FROM ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(p.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS d, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM posts p WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} AND p.created_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} - 1 DAY) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(p.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') UNION ALL SELECT DATE_FORMAT(c.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS d, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM comments c WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.created_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} - 1 DAY) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(c.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') ) x GROUP BY d ORDER BY d

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(access_hour, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, COUNT(*) AS count FROM stats_access_hourly WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND access_hour >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} - 1 DAY) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(access_hour, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY date
